What comes off the grill

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Souvlaki and sheftalia

Traditional pork souvlaki and sheftalia, the dishes guests name most often.

Liver and pork chops

Grilled liver and pork chops, with salad and dips on the side.

Meze

A meze with many dishes, fresh and plenty. 8 reviews mention the meze.

Vegetarian and take away

Vegetarian options too, and take away is possible.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Family run

Food prepared by the family who owns the place, guests write, fresh and with love.

Where locals eat

No frills, hearty food. Some guests have been coming for many years.

Call ahead on weekends

On Friday and Saturday it gets very busy, guests advise calling beforehand.

In Aglantzia

On Georgiou Griva Digeni in Aglantzia. Open every evening except Sunday from 18:00.

What guests say

Three of 173 Google reviews, 125 of them with five stars.

“Excellent family run souvlaki restaurant. We have pork souvlaki, liver, salad, dips, sheftalies and pork chops. Everything we tried tasted good. Service was fat and polite. Will definitely be back.”

Google review
“My absolute favourite place in the city. No flaff, come as you are, authentic, fresh, simple, clean, original Cypriot food. Lots of vegetarian options which are all impeccable. The consistency is impeccable, 5 stars, every single time (been dining here since 2013, atleast twice a month).”

Google review
“Ate there a few times and the kebabs and sheftalia are always top. No frills, hearty food where the locals eat”
